current_example.problem: What is the value of $5$ raised to the power of $3?$
current_example.worked_solution:
Here, $5$ raised to the power of $3$ means $5^3.$

To compute this power, we start by writing it out with multiplication signs:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129502/assets/5242476e967b676a0e040848e1e21d089ea6b68866b66df7246f48978adb9345.svg)

Now, we compute the product. Since $5 \times 5 = 25,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{{5\times 5}_{⏟}}_{25}\times 5 & =25\times 5.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we work out ${\color{blue}25} \times 5.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\,{}_{2}\,\,\,\, &  \\  &  & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,\times \,\,\,\, &  &  & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\, \\  & \,\,\,\,1\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,2\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,5\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $5^3=125.$
